ov: خطؤك (بالإسبانية: Culpa Tuya وبالإنجليزية: Your Fault) هو فلم دراما رومانسية إسباني صدر عام 2024 من إخراج دومينغو غونزاليس يستند إلى سلسلة "الخطاة" من تأليف مرسيدس رون وبطولة نيكول والاس وغابريل غيفارا . يعتبر تكملة مباشرة لفلم خطئي (2023).
plotEn:
On Noah Moran’s 18th birthday, her secret boyfriend Nick Leister is away doing a law internship in San Francisco. Melancholy, as her abusive father Jonás died a year ago, her closest friend Jenna reminds her they are about to graduate. Noah takes contraception and longs to be reunited with Nick. He makes a surprise entrance, gifting Noah with a heart shaped necklace and they embrace.
Nick and Noah have a fun summer with Lion and Jenna, but at a beach party, the men watch their girlfriends dance and Lion makes Nick scared that long-distance relationships are doomed to fail. Determined to prove him wrong, Nick rents a apartment nearby to Noah's college in a bid to see her more often. They get passionate, but Nick's confused reaction to Noah referring to the place as their shared one makes her feel embarrassed and insecure.
At a nightclub, Noah has girl-talk with Jenna over Nick's prior hesitancy, who boils the issue down to his fears of abandonment - specifically how his mother just up and left. Simultaneously, Nick confesses to Lion that his love for Noah cannot derail his mental block when the topic of commitment arises. Lion can only ramble about his overwhelming social and financial inadequacy. He fears disappointing his brother Luca over upholding the family business.
